questions.text: पहचान करें कि, किसी देश के राजस्व घाटे का अनुमान लगाते समय निम्नलिखित में से किस पर विचार 'नहीं' किया जाना चाहिए । (सही विकल्प का चयन करें ।)
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following is not to be considered while estimating Revenue Deficit of a country. (Choose the correct option)

options.A: सरकार द्वारा भुगतान की गई मजदूरी व वेतन
options.B: केन्द्रीय सरकार द्वारा किया गया ब्याज भुगतान
options.D: ऊपरीगामी पथ (flyover) के निर्माण पर व्यय

options_english.A: Wages and salaries paid by the government
options_english.B: Interest payments made by the Central Government
options_english.D: Expenditure incurred on construction of flyover

questions.solution: Revenue deficit is the excess of revenue expenditure over revenue receipts. Expenditure on the construction of a flyover is a capital expenditure, as it creates an asset for the government. Therefore, it is not considered when estimating revenue deficit.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन करें। निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से एक सही विकल्प का चयन करें : अभिकथन (A): सार्वजनिक वस्तुओं के संदर्भ में किसी भी व्यक्ति को लाभ उठाने से वंचित नहीं किया जा सकता है। कारण (R) : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ गैर-प्रतिद्वंद्वात्मक व गैर-अपवर्जनीय प्रकृति की होती हैं।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose one of the correct options given below: Assertion (A): In case of public goods no one can be excluded from enjoying the benefits. Reason (R): Public goods are non-rivalrous and non-excludable in nature.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Public goods are non-excludable because it is technically impossible or too expensive to exclude anyone from consuming them. Because they are non-excludable and non-rivalrous, no individual can be excluded from the benefits, making A and R both true and R the correct explanation.

questions.text: मूल्य संवर्धन = _______ - मध्यवर्ती उपभोग का मूल्य । (उपरोक्त सूत्र की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन करें)
questions.text_english: Value Addition = _______ - Value of Intermediate Consumption. (Choose the correct option(s) to complete the stated formula.)
questions.solution: Value of output can be expressed as (iii) Value of output or (iv) (Number of units produced) × (Price per unit). Therefore, both (iii) and (iv) are correct representations to complete the formula for Value Added.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में, स्वायत्त उपभोग ₹ 100 करोड़ है तथा कुल उपभोग ₹ 130 करोड़ है। प्रेरित उपभोग का मूल्य _______ करोड़ होगा।
questions.text_english: Suppose for an economy, autonomous consumption stands as 100 crore and total consumption is 130 crores. The value of induced consumption would be _______ crore.
questions.solution: Total consumption is the sum of autonomous consumption and induced consumption. Given total consumption of 130 crore and autonomous consumption of 100 crore, induced consumption is 130 - 100 = 30 crore.

questions.text: कीन्स के अर्थशास्त्र के अंतर्गत _______ को मूल बिंदु से प्रारंभ कर 45° कोण पर खींचा जाता है।
questions.text_english: In the Keynesian Economics, _______ starts from the origin and is always drawn at an angle of 45°. (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: The 45-degree line, often referred to as the reference line, represents points where aggregate supply equals income. It starts from the origin because at zero income, the line is zero.

questions.text: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में मौद्रिक नीति _______ द्वारा प्रतिपादित की जाती है।
questions.text_english: The monetary policy is formulated by the _______ in the Indian economy. (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: In India, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the central monetary authority responsible for formulating and implementing monetary policy to maintain price stability and economic growth.

questions.text: आय के संतुलन स्तर के मूल्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए प्रत्याक्षित _______ व प्रत्याक्षित _______ के मध्य समानता होनी चाहिए ।
questions.text_english: To arrive at the value of equilibrium level of income, there must exists an equality between ex-ante _______ and ex-ante ***.
questions.solution: Equilibrium in an economy is achieved when aggregate demand equals aggregate supply, or when planned (ex-ante) savings equals planned (ex-ante) investment. Therefore, (iii) Aggregate Demand, Investment (in a different framework) or (iv) Savings, Investment are correct depending on the model.

questions.text: वह बजट जिसके अंतर्गत, सरकार अपने द्वारा एकत्रित राजस्व के बराबर राशि व्यय कर सकती है, उसे _______ बजट कहा जाता है।
questions.text_english: The budget under, which the government may spend an amount equal to the revenue it collects is referred as _______ Budget.
questions.solution: A balanced budget is one where estimated government receipts are equal to estimated government expenditure in a financial year.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन करें। निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से एक सही विकल्प का चयन करें : अभिकथन (A) : यदि सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति का मान 0.5 है, तो सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति, सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति के बराबर होगी । कारण (R) : सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति व सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति का योग सदैव इकाई के बराबर होता है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose one of the correct options given below : Assertion (A): If the value of Marginal Propensity to Save is 0.5, Marginal Propensity to Consume will be equal to Marginal Propensity to Save. Reason (R): Sum of Marginal Propensity to Consume and Marginal Propensity to Save always equals to unity.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is false because if MPS is 0.5, MPC is also 1 - 0.5 = 0.5 in this specific case, but MPC is not generally equal to MPS. Reason (R) is true, as the sum of MPC and MPS always equals 1.

questions.text: बैंकों के बैंकर के रूप में, भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक _______ के अतिरिक्त सभी कार्य करता है।
questions.text_english: As the Banker to the Bank, Reserve Bank of India performs all functions except _______ (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)

options.A: जन साधारण की ओर से प्रतिभूतियों की खरीद और बिक्री
options.B: वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के चालू खाता रखने
options.C: अंतबैंकीय लेनदेनों का समाशोधन व भुगतान

options_english.A: Purchase and sale of securities on behalf of general public
options_english.B: Maintaining current account for Commercial Banks
options_english.C: Clearing and settlement of Interbank transactions

fill_values: जन साधारण की ओर से प्रतिभूतियों की खरीद और बिक्री
fill_values_hindi: Purchase and sale of securities on behalf of general public

questions.solution: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) acts as a banker to banks, maintaining accounts and clearing interbank transactions, but it does not deal directly with the general public for purchase and sale of securities in its capacity as a banker to banks.

questions.text: (a) "सरकार प्रायः सामाजिक रूप से अवांछनीय उत्पादों जैसे सिगरेट, तम्बाकू, मदिरा आदि पर अधिक वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) आरोपित करती है।" उपरोक्त कथन में इंगित सरकारी बजट उद्देश्य की पहचान व व्याख्या करें। अथवा (b) दो मित्र रमेश (एक सॉफ्टवेयर इंजीनियर) व पीहू (एक बेकरी मालिक), कर भुगतान के माध्यम से राष्ट्र की अर्थव्यवस्था में अपने-अपने योगदान पर चर्चा कर रहे हैं। रमेश प्रति वर्ष ₹8,00,000 कमाता है, जिसके कारण उसे आयकर देना पड़ता है। पीहू केक व पेस्ट्री की बिक्री पर वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) एकत्रित करती है तथा उसका भुगतान करती है। दिए गए गद्य के आधार पर पहचान करें कि रमेश प्रत्यक्ष कर अथवा अप्रत्यक्ष कर का भुगतान कर रहा है। दोनों कर प्रकारों के मध्य वैध अंतर की व्याख्या करें।
questions.text_english: (a) "The government generally levies higher Goods and Services Tax (GST) on socially undesirable products such as cigarettes, tobacco, liquor, etc." Identify and explain the government budget objective indicated in the given statement. OR (b) Two friends, Ramesh (a software engineer) and Pihu (a bakery owner), are discussing their contribution to the nation's economy through tax payments. Ramesh earns ₹8,00,000 per year, which makes him liable to pay income tax. Pihu collects Goods and Services Tax (GST) on the sale of cakes and pastries and pays it to the government. Based on the given text, identify whether Ramesh is paying a direct tax or an indirect tax. Explain valid differences between the two types of taxes.

key_points: Objective: Reallocation of resources to reduce consumption of harmful goods.
Difference: Direct taxes are paid by the person on whom it is levied (e.g., Income tax); Indirect taxes are passed on to others (e.g., GST).
Direct taxes burden cannot be shifted; Indirect taxes burden can be shifted.

questions.solution: The budget objective indicated in (a) is the reallocation of resources. By levying higher taxes on harmful goods, the government discourages their consumption and encourages the use of resources for more socially beneficial purposes. Regarding (b), Ramesh is paying direct tax because the liability for income tax falls directly on his earnings and cannot be shifted to anyone else. In contrast, indirect taxes like GST are collected by the producer or service provider but are ultimately borne by the final consumer, as the burden can be shifted.

questions.text: मौद्रिक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद को परिभाषित करें। यह किस प्रकार वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद से भिन्न है ?
questions.text_english: Define Nominal Gross Domestic Product. How is it different from Real Gross Domestic Product?

key_points: Definition: Nominal GDP is the market value of all final goods and services produced within a country during a year, measured at current year prices.
Difference: Nominal GDP includes the effect of inflation; Real GDP is measured at base year prices.
Real GDP is a better indicator of economic growth.

questions.solution: Nominal GDP is defined as the value of all final goods and services produced within a country during a year, estimated at current market prices. It differs from Real GDP because Nominal GDP is influenced by changes in price levels, meaning it can increase even if physical production remains the same. Real GDP, on the other hand, is calculated at constant prices of a base year, effectively removing the impact of inflation. This makes Real GDP a more accurate measure of the actual growth in production within an economy.

questions.text: मान लीजिए कि, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए सरकार ₹ 2,000 करोड़ के वृद्धिशील निवेश के साथ द्रुतगामी मार्गों के निर्माण की दो परियोजनाओं का प्रस्ताव रखती है। मान लीजिए कि, आय में वृद्धि का 80% उपभोग पर व्यय किया जाता है। उपरोक्त सूचना के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित का अनुमान लगाएँ : (a) आय में परिवर्तन (ΔY) (b) उपभोग में परिवर्तन (ΔC)
questions.text_english: Suppose for an economy, government proposes two investment projects for construction of expressways with an additional investment of 2000 crore. Assuming, 80% of increase in income is spent on consumption. Estimate the following on the basis of above information: (a) Change in income (ΔY). (b) Change in consumption (ΔC).

key_points: MPC = 0.8
Multiplier (k) = 1/(1-MPC) = 1/(1-0.8) = 5

sub_questions.solution: Given the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) is 80% or 0.8, the investment multiplier (k) is 1/(1-0.8) = 5. With an initial change in investment (ΔI) of 2000 crore, the change in income (ΔY) is calculated as ΔY = k × ΔI, which is 5 × 2000 = 10,000 crore.

key_points: ΔC = MPC * ΔY

sub_questions.solution: The change in consumption (ΔC) is the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) multiplied by the change in income (ΔY). Therefore, ΔC = 0.8 × 10,000 = 8,000 crore.

questions.solution: The investment multiplier effect determines the total change in income, while the consumption function determines the change in consumption based on that income.

questions.text: (A) दिए गए चित्र के आधार पर, निर्दिष्ट समष्टिगत आर्थिक मुद्दे को नियंत्रित करने के लिए भारत सरकार द्वारा अपनाए जा सकने वाले कदमों की व्याख्या करें । (B) 'खुली बाज़ार कार्यवाही' को परिभाषित करें ।
questions.text_english: (A) On the basis of the given image, explain the steps which may be taken by the Government of India to control the indicated macro-economic issue. (B) Define 'Open Market Operations'.

sub_questions.text: समष्टिगत आर्थिक मुद्दे को नियंत्रित करने के कदम
sub_questions.text_english: Steps to control the indicated macro-economic issue (Inflation)

key_points: Issue: Inflation.
Fiscal measures: Reducing government expenditure, increasing taxes to lower aggregate demand.

sub_questions.solution: The image highlights the issue of inflation. To control inflation, the government can adopt fiscal measures such as reducing public expenditure and increasing taxes. By doing so, the government reduces the disposable income of individuals, thereby lowering aggregate demand and exerting downward pressure on price levels.

key_points: RBI's sale and purchase of government securities in the open market.

sub_questions.solution: Open Market Operations (OMO) refer to the buying and selling of government securities by the Central Bank (RBI) in the open market to regulate the money supply in the economy.

questions.solution: The problem shown is inflation. Fiscal policy involves adjusting government spending and taxes to manage aggregate demand. Open Market Operations are a monetary policy tool.

questions.text: (a) निम्नलिखित कथनों की मान्य तर्कों द्वारा पुष्टि करें : (i) किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में मुद्रा आपूर्ति स्टॉक चर का उदाहरण है। (ii) केन्द्रीय बैंक सरकार को विभिन्न बैंकिंग सेवाएँ प्रदान करता है। अथवा (b) किसी काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए यह मानते हुए कि, केन्द्रीय बैंक आरक्षित अनुपात को 20% से बढ़ाकर 25% कर देता है तथा कुल प्राथमिक जमा राशि ₹ 1,000 है। वाणिज्यिक बैंकों द्वारा साख सृजन पर आरक्षित अनुपात में वृद्धि के प्रभाव की व्याख्या करें ।
questions.text_english: (a) Justify the following statements with valid arguments: (i) Money supply in an economy is an example of a stock variable. (ii) The Central Bank provides several Banking services to the government. OR (b) Assuming for a hypothetical economy, Central Bank increases the Reserve Ratio from 20% to 25% and the total primary deposits stand at 1,000. Explain the effect of rise in Reserve Ratio on credit creation by commercial banks.

key_points: (a)(i): Money supply is a stock variable because it is measured at a particular point in time.
(a)(ii): Central bank maintains government accounts, acts as a fiscal agent, and advises on policy.
(b): Credit creation = Primary deposits * (1/RR). With 20%, credit = 1000 * 5 = 5000. With 25%, credit = 1000 * 4 = 4000. Increase in reserve ratio reduces credit creation.

questions.solution: (a) (i) Money supply is considered a stock variable because it represents the total volume of money held by the public at a specific point in time, not over a period. (ii) The Central Bank acts as a banker, fiscal agent, and advisor to the government by maintaining public accounts, managing national debt, and formulating financial policies. In (b), when the Reserve Ratio increases from 20% to 25%, the money multiplier decreases. Specifically, the credit creation capacity falls from 5000 (1000 * (1/0.2)) to 4000 (1000 * (1/0.25)), showing that a higher reserve requirement restricts the lending capacity of commercial banks.
questions.topic: Money Supply / Central Bank Functions / Credit Creation

questions.text: निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : भुगतान संतुलन (BoP) एक निश्चित समयावधि में किसी अर्थव्यवस्था के शेष विश्व के साथ आर्थिक लेन-देनों को व्यवस्थित रूप से सारांशित करता है। BoP को मुख्यतः दो खातों में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है : चालू खाता पूँजी खाता चालू खाता किसी अर्थव्यवस्था व शेष विश्व के बीच वस्तुओं, सेवाओं, आय व अंतरण के हस्तांतरण को मापता है। चालू खाता दृश्य व अदृश्य खाते में भी विभाजित किया जाता है। दृश्य खाते में वस्तुओं के निर्यात व आयात से संबंधित लेन-देन सम्मिलित होते हैं। अदृश्य खाते में तीन व्यापक श्रेणियाँ हैं : गैर-कारक सेवाएँ जैसे यात्रा, परिवहन, बीमा आदि । ऐसे अंतरण जिनमें विनिमय में कोई मूल्य सम्मिलित नहीं होता है। आय जिसमें कर्मचारियों का पारिश्रमिक व निवेश आय शामिल है। पूँजी खाता शेष विश्व पर वित्तीय दावों में शुद्ध परिवर्तन को दर्शाता है। पूँजी खाते को मुख्यतः दो श्रेणियों में विभाजित किया जा सकता है : गैर-ऋण प्रवाह जैसे प्रत्यक्ष व पोर्टफोलियो निवेश ऋण प्रवाह जैसे बाह्य सहायता, वाणिज्यिक उधार, अनिवासी जमा आदि । दोनों खातों का योग समग्र शेष राशि को दर्शाता है, जो अधिशेष व घाटे में हो सकती है। समग्र शेष राशि में होने वाला परिवर्तन देश के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय भंडार में होने वाले परिवर्तनों में परिलक्षित होता है।
questions.text_english: Balance of Payments (BoP) systematically summarise, the economic transactions of an economy with the rest of the world, over a given period of time. The BoP can be broadly divided into two accounts namely: current account capital account The current account measures the transfer of goods, services, income and transfers between an economy and rest of the world. The current account may be sub-divided into merchandise account and invisible account. Merchandise account consists of transactions related to export and import of goods. In the invisible account, there are three broad categories: Non-factor services such as travel, transportation, insurance etc. Transfer which do not involve any value in exchange. Income which includes compensation of employees and investment income. The capital account reflects the net changes in financial claims on rest of the world. The capital account can be broadly broken up into two categories: Non-debt flows such as direct and portfolio investments. Debt flows such as external assistance, commercial borrowings, non-resident deposits etc. The sum of the two accounts indicates the overall balance, which could be either be in surplus or deficit. The movement in overall balance is reflected in changes in international reserves of the country.

key_points: Systematic summary of economic transactions with the rest of the world over a period.

sub_questions.solution: Balance of Payments (BoP) is a systematic record of all economic transactions between residents of an economy and the rest of the world during a given period of time.

sub_questions.text: भुगतान संतुलन के दोनों खातों के मध्य अंतर स्पष्ट करें।
sub_questions.text_english: Differentiate between the two accounts of Balance of Payments.

key_points: Current Account: Goods, services, income transfers.
Capital Account: Financial assets, liabilities, debt/non-debt flows.

sub_questions.solution: The Current Account measures transactions in goods, services, income, and transfers, reflecting the current flows of an economy. The Capital Account reflects the net change in financial claims on the rest of the world, including investments and debt flows, focusing on assets and liabilities.

sub_questions.text: भुगतान संतुलन के घाटे का अर्थ सूत्र सहित बताएँ ।
sub_questions.text_english: Give the meaning of Balance of Payments deficit with formula.

key_points: Deficit = Receipts < Payments in autonomous transactions.
Formula: Autonomous receipts < Autonomous payments.

sub_questions.solution: A Balance of Payments deficit occurs when the total autonomous payments exceed total autonomous receipts. The formula is expressed as BoP Deficit = Autonomous Payments - Autonomous Receipts. This indicates an overall shortfall in foreign exchange earnings from international transactions.

questions.solution: The passage outlines the structure of the Balance of Payments and its components, explaining current and capital account functions and the implications of overall balance.

questions.text:
(a) (i) निम्नलिखित आँकड़ों के आधार पर, साधन लागत पर सकल राष्ट्रीय उत्पाद (GNP_FC) का अनुमान लगाएँ : (1) निजी अंतिम उपभोग व्यय: 2,000 (2) सरकारी अंतिम उपभोग व्यय: 1,500 (3) सकल घरेलू स्थिर पूँजी निर्माण: 1,000 (4) स्टॉक में परिवर्तन: 400 (5) स्थायी पूँजी का उपभोग: 50 (6) विदेशों से प्राप्त निवल कारक आय: 100 (7) शुद्ध अप्रत्यक्ष कर: 200 (8) शुद्ध निर्यात: 700 (ii) धनात्मक बाह्यताओं व ऋणात्मक बाह्यताओं में अंतर स्पष्ट करें।
अथवा
(b) (i) गौहर ने हाल ही में अपनी फैशन डिजाइनिंग की पढ़ाई पूरी की है तथा एक बुटीक प्रारंभ किया है। बिक्री के लिए कपड़े बनाने के लिए उसने एक सिलाई मशीन, कपड़ा, बटन व धागे क्रय किए हैं। ये सभी वस्तुएँ कपड़े बनाने के लिए आवश्यक हैं। गौहर द्वारा क्रय किए गए सामान को अंतिम वस्तुओं व मध्यवर्ती वस्तुओं में वैध कारणों द्वारा वर्गीकृत करें। (ii) "एक द्वि-क्षेत्रक अर्थव्यवस्था में, राष्ट्रीय आय सदैव घरेलू आय से अधिक होती है।" मान्य तर्कों द्वारा उपरोक्त कथन का समर्थन अथवा खंडन करें।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) On the basis of the data given below, estimate the value of Gross National Product at Factor Cost (GNP_FC): (1) Private final consumption expenditure: 2,000 (2) Government final consumption expenditure: 1,500 (3) Gross domestic fixed capital formation: 1,000 (4) Change in stocks: 400 (5) Consumption of fixed capital: 50 (6) Net factor income from abroad: 100 (7) Net indirect taxes: 200 (8) Net exports: 700
(ii) Differentiate between positive externalities and negative externalities.
OR
(b) (i) Gauhar has recently completed her fashion designing studies and started a boutique. To produce dresses for sale, she purchased a sewing machine, fabric, buttons, and thread. These items are essential for producing the dresses. Classify the items purchased by Gauhar as final or intermediate goods, giving valid reasons in support of the classification.
(ii) "In a two-sector economy, national income is always more than domestic income." Defend or refute the given statement with reasons.

key_points: GDP_MP = Private + Govt + (Fixed + Stock) + Net Exports
GNP_FC = GDP_MP + NFIA - NIT

sub_questions.solution: GDP_MP = Private final consumption + Govt final consumption + Gross domestic fixed capital formation + Addition to stock + Net exports = 2000 + 1500 + 1000 + 400 + 700 = 5600. GNP_FC = GDP_MP + Net factor income from abroad - Net indirect taxes = 5600 + 100 - 200 = 5500 crore.

key_points: Positive: Benefit to third party without compensation.
Negative: Cost or harm to third party without compensation.

sub_questions.solution: Positive externalities occur when the actions of a person or firm confer benefits on others without receiving any payment, such as a garden improving neighborhood ambiance. Negative externalities occur when these actions impose harmful costs on others, such as pollution.

questions.solution: National income calculations require precise classification of variables. Externality distinctions are key to welfare economics.

questions.text: हाल के वर्षों में, सभी वयस्कों को _______ योजना के अंतर्गत खाता खोलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन करें ।)
questions.text_english: In recent years, all the adults are encouraged to open bank accounts as a part of a scheme known as _______ (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is the Indian government's scheme to ensure financial inclusion by encouraging all households to open bank accounts.

questions.text: दिया गया चित्र 1990-92 के उपरांत, भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में _______ की समस्या को इंगित करता है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन करें ।)
questions.text_english: The given chart indicates the problem of _______ post 1990-92 in the Indian Economy. (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: The graph clearly illustrates a trend where GDP growth increases significantly while employment growth remains low or stagnant, a classic characteristic of 'Jobless Growth'.
questions.chapter: Employment: Growth, Informalisation and Other Issues

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : कथन 1 : माँग व पूर्ति के संबंध के उत्क्रमण के कारण, अपशिष्ट उत्पादन व प्रदूषण की पर्यावरणीय चिंताएँ गंभीर हो गई हैं। कथन 2 : पर्यावरणीय संकट तब उत्पन्न होता है, जब संसाधनों के निष्कर्षण की दर संसाधनों के पुनर्जनन की दर से कम होती है। दिए गए कथन के आधार पर निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प चुनें :
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: Environmental concerns of waste generation and pollution have become critical, due to reversal of demand and supply relationship. Statement 2: Environmental crisis happens, when the rate of resource extraction is less than that of regeneration of resource. In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is true regarding environmental concerns. Statement 2 is false because an environmental crisis typically occurs when resource extraction exceeds the rate of regeneration, not when it is less than it.

questions.text: अपने खेत/व्यवसाय आदि का स्वतंत्र रूप से संचालन करने वाले व्यक्ति _______ कहलाते हैं।
questions.text_english: *** are the people who operate their own farms/enterprises. (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: Individuals who own and operate their own businesses or farms to earn a living are classified as self-employed.
questions.chapter: Employment: Growth, Informalisation and Other Issues

questions.text: कृषि विपणन एक ऐसी प्रक्रिया है, जिसमें कृषि वस्तुओं का _______ सम्मिलित होता है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन करें ।) (i) निजीकरण (ii) प्रसंस्करण (iii) संयोजन (iv) ग्रेडिंग
questions.text_english: Agricultural marketing is a process that involves the _______ of agricultural commodities. (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank) (i) Privatisation (ii) Processing (iii) Assembling (iv) Grading
questions.solution: Agricultural marketing involves activities like assembling, storage, processing, transportation, packaging, grading, and distribution of agricultural produce. Privatisation is not a stage in this process.

questions.text: _______ इस विचार पर आधारित है कि, शिक्षा व स्वास्थ्य मानव कल्याण के अभिन्न अंग हैं।
questions.text_english: _______ is based on the idea that education and health are integral to human well-being. (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: The concept of Human Development emphasizes that the purpose of development is to create an environment where people can develop their full potential and lead productive, creative lives, with education and health as core components.

questions.text: कृषि का _______ स्व-उपभोग के बजाये खुले बाज़ार में बिक्री के लिए उत्पादित फसलों को संदर्भित करता है।
questions.text_english: _______ of agriculture refers to production of crops for sale in the open market rather than for self consumption purpose.
questions.solution: The commercialisation of agriculture occurs when farmers shift from producing crops for self-consumption (subsistence farming) to producing crops for market sale.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : कथन 1: 1978 में, कम्यून भूमि को खेती के लिये व्यक्तिगत गृहस्थों को छोटे-छोटे भूखंडों में विभाजित करके दिया गया था । कथन 2 : कम्यून व्यवस्था के अंतर्गत, पेशेवरों को काम करने व सीखने के लिए ग्रामीण इलाकों से प्रेषित किया जाता था । दिए गए कथन के आधार पर निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प चुनें :
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: In 1978, commune lands were divided into small plots to the individual households for cultivation. Statement 2: Under commune system, professionals were sent to work and learn from the country side. In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is correct regarding the 1978 Chinese agricultural reforms. Statement 2 is false; it was common for people in rural areas to be sent to work and learn, but the commune system itself focused on collective work.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text: उन विकल्पों का चयन करें, जो कि सूचना और प्रौद्योगिकी की भूमिका को उजागर करते हैं। (i) धारणीय विकास प्रदान करना (ii) खाद्य सुरक्षा की प्राप्ति (iii) उभरती प्रौद्योगिकी के बारे में जानकारी प्रसारित करना
questions.text_english: Identify, the options that emphasize the role of information and technology. (i) Achieving sustainable development (ii) Attainment of food security (iii) Disseminates information regarding emerging technologies.
questions.solution: Information and technology play a vital role in disseminating knowledge about new farming practices (iii) and helping achieve food security (ii) through better efficiency and data management.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) का अध्ययन करें। निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से एक सही विकल्प का चयन करें : अभिकथन (A) : भूमि सुधार के अंतर्गत, भारत सरकार द्वारा किसी व्यक्ति के स्वामित्व की न्यूनतम सीमा का आकार निर्धारित किया गया था। कारण (R) : भूमि सीमा निर्धारण का उद्देश्य भू-स्वामित्व को कुछ हाथों में केन्द्रित होने से रोकना था ।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose one of the correct options given below : Assertion (A): Under the land reforms, Indian government fixed the minimum land size which could be owned by an individual. Reason (R): The purpose of land ceiling was to avoid the concentration of land ownership in a few hands.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is false because land ceiling laws fixed the *maximum* size of land holding an individual could own, not the minimum. Reason (R) is true, as the objective was indeed to prevent concentration of land ownership.

questions.text: (a) मेध्या व दानिश दोनों के पास अपने खेत थे। मेध्या ने कुछ कृषि पाठ्यक्रमों में निवेश किया, आधुनिक कृषि की तकनीकें सीखीं व अपने मजदूरों को मृदा उर्वरता, मृदा प्रबंधन, कीट नियंत्रण आदि के सर्वोत्तम तरीकों का प्रशिक्षण प्रदान किया। जबकि दानिश ने उन्नत कृषि मशीनरी, सिंचाई प्रणाली व उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले बीजों के क्रय पर भारी निवेश किया। क्या आप इस बात से सहमत हैं कि दानिश ने मानव पूँजी में निवेश किया है? अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में मान्य कारण दें। अथवा (b) "प्रतिषेधी आयुर्विज्ञान, चिकित्सीय आयुर्विज्ञान व सामाजिक आयुर्विज्ञान पर व्यय मानव पूँजी व आर्थिक विकास के निर्माण में उपयुक्त सहायता करता है।" क्या आप उपरोक्त कथन से सहमत हैं? अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में मान्य तर्क प्रस्तुत करें।
questions.text_english: (a) Medhya and Danish both had their own farms. Medhya invested in agricultural courses, learned modern agricultural techniques, and trained her labourers in best practices related to soil fertility, crop management, pest control, etc. In contrast, Danish invested heavily in advanced agricultural machinery, irrigation systems, and high-quality seeds. Do you agree that Danish made an investment in human capital? Give valid reasons in support of your answer. OR (b) "Expenditure on preventive medicine, curative medicine, and social medicine helps in building human capital and contributes to economic development." Do you agree with the given statement? Give valid arguments in support of your answer.

key_points: (a): Danish invested in Physical Capital, not Human Capital. Human capital requires investment in health, education, or skill development.
(b): Yes, expenditure on health (preventive, curative, social medicine) increases labor productivity and life expectancy, which are essential for human capital formation.

questions.solution: (a) No, Danish has not invested in human capital. His investments in machinery, irrigation, and seeds are investments in physical capital. Medhya, by investing in education and training, has invested in human capital. (b) Yes, I agree. Expenditure on health, including preventive (vaccination), curative (medical treatment), and social (sanitation) medicine, directly boosts worker productivity and efficiency, leading to stronger human capital and long-term economic growth.
questions.topic: Human vs Physical Capital / Investment in Health

questions.text: चीन द्वारा अपनाई गई दोहरी मूल्य निर्धारण नीति का संक्षिप्त वर्णन करें ।
questions.text_english: Briefly explain the dual pricing policy adopted by China.

key_points: System where farmers and industrial units were required to buy/sell fixed quantities at government-fixed prices.
Any production beyond the quota could be sold at market prices.

questions.solution: China's dual pricing policy required farmers and industrial units to produce and sell a fixed quantity of goods to the government at government-mandated prices. Any production exceeding this quota could be sold by producers at prevailing market prices, incentivizing greater output and efficiency.

questions.text_english: (a) "In recent times, through various schemes and policies, the Government of India has taken vital initiatives to generate employment directly and indirectly." Justify the statement with valid arguments. OR (b) "Microcredit programmes have been very helpful in supporting rural development and improving livelihoods in India." Do you agree with the given statement? Give valid reasons in support of your answer.

key_points: (a): Schemes like MGNREGA (direct employment), 'Make in India' (indirect), Start-up India (entrepreneurial employment).
(b): Yes, micro-credit provides access to affordable capital for small-scale ventures, promotes self-employment, and reduces dependency on high-interest informal lenders.

questions.solution: (a) The Indian government has launched various initiatives to generate employment. Directly, MGNREGA provides guaranteed wage employment in rural areas. Indirectly, policies like 'Make in India' and 'Start-up India' focus on industrial growth and fostering entrepreneurship, creating new job opportunities across diverse sectors. (b) Yes, I agree that micro-credit programmes are crucial. They empower rural households by providing small, collateral-free loans for productive activities, enabling self-employment, improving income stability, and reducing dependence on exploitative informal moneylenders, thereby fostering rural development.

questions.text_english: On the basis of the given data, compare and analyse the Distribution of workforce and its contribution to Gross Value added in India and China.

key_points: Compare Agriculture (India high reliance, China lower).
Industry/Service sector contributions (China's industry dominance, India's service-led growth).
Note the efficiency of workforce distribution.

questions.solution: The data reveals significant structural differences. In India, a larger share of the workforce (43%) is engaged in agriculture, yet it contributes only 16% to GVA. Conversely, China has a more diversified workforce, with only 26% in agriculture contributing 7% to GVA, while their industrial sector contributes a massive 41% to GVA with 28% of the workforce. This indicates China has achieved a more productive workforce distribution compared to India, where the dependency on the agricultural sector remains disproportionately high relative to its economic contribution.

questions.text_english: Explain, the volume and direction of foreign trade during the British rule.

key_points: Volume: Net exporter of primary goods, importer of finished goods.
Direction: Export trade was restricted primarily to Britain (monopoly).
Drain of Wealth.

questions.solution: During the British rule, India’s foreign trade underwent drastic changes. The volume of trade was characterized by large exports of primary agricultural goods (raw materials) to feed British industries and large imports of expensive manufactured finished goods from Britain. Regarding the direction of trade, it was heavily monopolized by Britain, which controlled more than 50% of India's trade, forcing India to become an export market for raw materials to fuel British industrialization and a market for finished products.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : जलवायु परिवर्तन व पर्यावरणीय वहनीयता दो ऐसे महत्त्वपूर्ण मुद्दे हैं, जिन्होंने वैश्विक स्तर पर ध्यान आकर्षित किया है। विगत वर्षों में, विश्व में प्रतिकूल जलवायु संबंधित घटनाओं में वृद्धि अनुभव की गई है। इसमें गंभीर अकाल, बादल फटना, बाढ़, भूस्खलन, घटते समुद्री तट, आर्कटिक बर्फ़ व हिमालय के ग्लेशियरों का खतरनाक रूप से पिघलना सम्मिलित हैं। जंगल में आग लगने की घटनाओं में निरंतर वृद्धि हो रही है। इस संदर्भ में, धारणीय कृषि एक महत्त्वपूर्ण समाधान के रूप में उभर कर आयी है। इससे तात्पर्य उन कृषि पद्धतियों से है, जो वर्तमान आवश्यकताओं की पूर्ति करते हुए भविष्य की पीढ़ियों के लिए संसाधनों को संरक्षित करती है। इसका अर्थ है कि, ऐसे उपाय अपनाना जो कि पर्यावरण की रक्षा करते हैं, रासायनिक कारकों पर निर्भरता कम करते हैं, जल व भूमि का कुशलतम प्रयोग करते हैं तथा कृषकों के लिए सामाजिक आर्थिक समानता सुनिश्चित करते हैं। एक तरफ धारणीय कृषि पद्धतियाँ आवश्यक हैं, दूसरी ओर इन्हें लागू करना पारंपरिक कृषि की तुलना में प्रायः अधिक महँगा होता है। जैविक कृषि, स्मार्ट जलवायु तकनीक, आधुनिक सिंचाई प्रणाली जैसी धारणीय प्रथाएँ प्रारंभ में महँगी लग सकती है, परन्तु वे उत्पादकता व पर्यावरण संरक्षण में सुधार करके दीर्घकालिक लाभ प्रदान करती है। सुलभ व किफायती वित्तीय विकल्पों के बिना कृषि प्रथाओं में आवश्यक परिवर्तन कई लोगों के लिए दूर का सपना ही बना रहेगा । इसलिए, धारणीय वित्त को न केवल पर्यावरण अनुकूल प्रथाओं को प्रोत्साहित करना, बल्कि यह भी सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि जरूरतमंद कृषकों को वित्तीय संसाधन उपलब्ध हो ।
questions.text_english: Read the following text carefully: Climate change and sustainability of environment are two pressing issues that have captured global attention. In recent years, the world has witnessed a surge in extreme weather events including severe droughts, cloud bursts, floods, land slides, receding coastlines and the alarming melting of arctic ice and Himalayan Glaciers. Wildfires have become more frequent and intense. In this context, sustainable agriculture emerges as a crucial solution. This refers to those farming practices that meet today's requirements while preserving resources for the future generation. This means adopting methods that protect the environment, reduce dependence on chemical inputs, efficiently using water and land and ensuring socio-economic equity for farmers. On one hand sustainable agricultural practices are necessary, on the other, they are often more expensive to implement compared to conventional methods. Sustainable practices like organic farming, climate smart technologies, modern irrigation system may seem costly upfront, but they offer long-term benefits by improving productivity, and environmental stewardship. Without accessible and affordable financing options, the much needed shift to sustainable farming practices will remain a distant dream for many. Therefore, sustainable finance should not only promote eco-friendly practices but also ensure that financial resources are available to the farmers who need it.

key_points: Meeting present needs without compromising future generations.

sub_questions.solution: Sustainable development is defined as a development process that meets the needs of the current generation without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
